label: C · Daily overview
prompt:
Create ONE full-fidelity desktop application UI mockup, landscape 1600 by 1000, straight-on pixel-perfect screenshot appearance. This is a composition proposal for a new WINDOWS Electron + React personal assistant, working name JaxOS. Use the attached actual Hermes Desktop screenshot ONLY as visual reference for its quiet icy blue / white flat desktop material, hairlines, spacious text, compact sidebar and restrained cobalt actions. Do not reproduce Hermes branding, its large wordmark, Mac traffic lights, or its exact content. Use a native-looking Windows top bar with minimize, maximize and close at the top right, simple original small JaxOS mark at top left. Palette: #f8faff background, #f3f7ff sidebar, white primary content, #17171a primary text, #0053fd accent. Readable Segoe UI-style sans typography, consistent thin line icons. No browser address bar, device bezel, photographic scene, gradients, decorative glass, nested cards, giant hero text, or marketing. UI controls must look usable, aligned and finely crafted, with enough negative space. Show visible small 'Concept · sample data' text in the top bar, so illustrative content cannot be mistaken for live activity. Four mode names must be easy to find: Brainstorm, Daily, Build, Test. Sidebar project is 'Blueprint' with honest 'Not connected' indicator and 'Open project' action. Do NOT show successful tests, invented connected repositories, or fabricated completed work. This is a design image, not an actual functioning app.
COMPOSITION C: A daily-driver home that gives work context first and keeps the assistant at hand. Full-height 220px left navigation sidebar with Today selected, Conversations, Projects, Memory, Skills. The remaining area has a slim top title 'Today' and four mode controls Brainstorm, Daily, Build, Test with Daily selected. Central content is a spacious editorial work agenda about 850px wide, with heading 'What would make today useful?' at a restrained 30px UI size, short supporting line 'Pick up a thought, choose a next step, or start something new.' No giant marketing hero. Flat sections, not a dashboard of cards: 'Continue a conversation' with two rows 'Personal desktop assistant' / 'Explore the four-mode workflow' and 'Ideas for the week' / 'Choose one useful experiment'; 'Next steps' with unchecked rows 'Connect the Blueprint project', 'Agree on the first milestone', 'Define acceptance checks'; 'Decisions to keep' with a simple editable note 'Windows desktop. Electron + React. Visual design before implementation.' At right a persistent 360px assistant dock titled 'JaxOS', short conversation 'Let’s choose one achievable result for today.' with action 'Help me prioritize', plus bottom message composer. The central content has a visible modest 'New conversation' action. Sidebar shows Blueprint as Not connected, Open project, no fake active integrations. Preserve the same icy blue, white, charcoal and cobalt language and high-quality Windows chrome as the reference. This structure must feel materially different from chat-first or IDE layout: agenda is the focal object, assistant is a useful companion dock. All text crisp, tasteful spacing, entire application window visible.
